RuntimeReadability.description:
Whether the Runtime's own UID can read an External Root.

``UNVERIFIED`` is the only member, and that is the honest shape of this
response rather than a placeholder. Runtime-side path validation requires
the Host Agent; the read-only calls ``GetHostInfo``, ``ListGPUs`` and
``StreamLogs`` cannot validate a path. A second member requires a wired
validation call. Until then the state is stated, never omitted and never
folded into the accepted conclusion.
RuntimeReadability.title: RuntimeReadability

RuntimeReadabilityUnverifiedCause.description: Why the Runtime-side answer is absent.  Not an error, a known gap.
RuntimeReadabilityUnverifiedCause.title: RuntimeReadabilityUnverifiedCause

description:
A server path the control plane judged usable, and what it did not judge.

The body carries no path: not the submitted value, not its ``realpath``
and not the allowed root that matched.

``runtime_readability`` is always present. Runtime-side path validation
requires the Host Agent and is unavailable through the read-only
``GetHostInfo``, ``ListGPUs`` and ``StreamLogs`` methods, so the field
states "unverified" and names why.  A client that renders this
as "readable" is contradicting the field, not filling a gap.
title: ExternalPathAcceptedResponse
